difficulty_reason: The authors introduce an iteration whose error is controlled by squared approximation errors at nearby powers and linearly weighted errors at lower powers. Coupling this with multiplicative approximate counting and a precision-versus-exponent recursion yields a nonroutine uniform logarithmic-depth matrix-powering algorithm.
